book.name: 2 Korin
book.title: 2 Korin Polva Moamba Ambara Levraholothunna, Andrava Sesoava Daswolna Moalamangnindm.

content: Kava Pol, moalamangnindrini Kristus Yesusna. Kava lohv moalamangnindrinielmba, noinda osm Sesoava indva vrevna. Ka eva Timoti, pivna mongawa andranindrini Kristusna, kasambla honamba tombaiva novol evepiprinv yem Sesoanindm Korinnindram, eva Sesoatindim indkumbim vavawonam, nom ten eungu vevm Akaiaprovinsra.
Sesoa ara eva Yesus Kristus pivna mendekli yem undalm vewol evevra, wo yimba os undwonam avra.
Polva Omnana Sesoam, Yimba Lehra.
Okulivm Sesoam aram pivna mendeklinam Yesus Kristusnam. Sesoava aramba himba plalm dathowulluhv wavranamba. Himba Sesoa av, vi vovhoawol velmba, kinnamba temba avpa.

Mana vema kinda, himba elsus kana undmba vi vovhoawol veluhunv, wo os evata kava mongla indhanamba vinvra, ovra, himba nomba kin ianga vev. Kava no monana vinvra, Sesoa kavm ten und vi vovhoawol vevnam.
Kamba vinvra snakinnata eva, os Kristus ten guanam. Wo no monanata Kristusva kamba und vi vovhoawol vinv.

Kava kinnamba allava, temba yena pevna undm, os noinda undwonam lohra, wo Sesoava si yemba osrava henga unvra hevelm. Kamba und vi vovhoawol vitava, wo osva yimba si avav undwonam. Wo honamba yemba kolvrowol vevav, velmba moahui hona kinmba, snamba memba kava lopsho avramana vev. Sesoava nengavnangva os vrevna.
Kava os ninginv yemba, yimba si keknam avav pevna undnahonarava. Wo kava nonora lohv, osva yimba viv kana kinna. Osoa kav vei, nonora lohv, osva ye vei, und vi vovhoangav, osta men kam vinvm.

Seh, kava ninginv yemba, osm levrapieivra kinmoa, nomoa temba kava lopsho avramana vevnamba diva Asiaprovinsrava. Kinmba snavema kamba prunvna diva, snavemava ovna i. Wo heva os kava kavna nengavnangva vrivna, os si kamba mueisowa vilovav.

Tanamolnam kava keknam ningvna, osva kamba si dalvra. Wo heva os honamba osm vena, kava kavmba si osva uvramoa, lehra kakowa. Memba osm vena, kava si Sesoamangas amnavra, he wolapho vev indhanamba hengava pokamariniva. Kamba doa kolvrowol vena, maim oi, pokamarini pulvona.

Doa kamba dalvna, heva os Sesoa kamba lopshana mana vemakoklariniva. Wo himba si yunalmba osangas wohvaowinvra kamba. Kava doa kavna undna nengavnangnamba heinda huhlina, wo himba si kamba henga lopshavav.
Wo yeoa kamoa kolvrowol vemb vevm pevna sembayangna. Wo indkumbiva indhanamba si Sesoamba os umnivra, lehra, osra yimba Poltowondnamba awothowol vev, noinda mindnamba phunv henamba sembayangmba.
Polva Moamba Kukunnamoa Korinnindmba.

Men honinda kava eisilva av, wo kava os nengv, memba tanam. Manara manara memba kava vivpa hona petharava, kava vildav tanamangasm, nomba Sesoanaminiangas, wo eva wevsabesalnonoam. Wo memba honamba mendeklinonoa tanamolnam, nomba manimani memba kava vinvpa yemba. Kava honamba viv Sesoana wavrana, sna nowolnamba owai, memba manimani huiva petharava nonamba lohvpa.
Kava memba novol vipiprinvpa yemba, ambo os nunglu, eva osm levrapivolo. Wo kava os nengv,

osva ora, yimba doa wohkevriv keknam nomba manam manam kanamba. Kava yemba moamba mongova komandhinnamoa. Wo yimba si os moaholmonamba eishunvra kamba, os kav si yem wivewol ovovav no nambainam, pivna mendekli Yesus Kristus henga prunvram.
Kava nonora lohv, yimba kamba temura lihawol viv kana nengavnangmba. Noinda osva kava seilva nengavnangva vrena, nongalkalmba yemba doarava. Wo osrava yemba si awothowol vivra samblalm.

Memba osm, kava nengavnangva vrena, nongalkohalm yemba momnanam, gavrava Masetoniam, wo eva hengam, osm nomini provram. Eva kava undva vrev, yenaminim kolvralm, osm kava nona lohmana vevav domba Yutiaprovinsramba. Heva os kava kavna nengavnangva henga weihaloh vrena, noinda kava yemba mongawulmba nongalkana.

Wo es hevpa yimba os ningvmi, kava ambo hona nengavnangva vrena, yem daswotalm a? A yimba os ningvmi, kava hona nengavnangva vrena, os ten hona pethanind vrivm, wo kava ata osva os ovov mongawamolm, lehra, lehrata, wo owai, owainonoa?
Wo heva os yimba keknamba amnatava Sesoamba, wo yimba osva keknam avra honindava, memba kava yemba eishoraohvpa, wo mongawatilmba osva lohohrava elohwolvavmoa, vera, lehra, eva owai.

Ka, Sailas, Timoti, kava yemba doa eishoraohna Yesus Kristusna moamba. Wo yimba nonora pev av, osva Kristusva osva owol vevmoa, osva tanam, tanamta, eva owai, owainonoa. Himba osangas owol vev, tanam, tanamta. Manara, himba mona, Sesoana omokalthamomba heinam prov, wo nomba henaminiva vevpa, piinam prunv.

Sesoava doa pimba ovlahinna moamba mendekli. No Sesoana moarava Kristusva osva olohv, tanam. Noinda nonamba pimba Sesoana moamba hillivpa, pimba Sesoam os umniv, tanam, Yesus Kristusina. Wo pimba Sesoana nihilmba opivolv.
Wo Sesoa memba, pimba moakot vena mongasalalmba Kristusindava. Sesoa kekaiv vena pimba hevtindinonowalm.
Sesoa pimba wikik hohloprinna, osm ona, memba kana. Wo hev vena, hevsongol sandhinvna pina nihmera, nonam nengviluwuvulm, noindam manam manam hev ten ovrahunnam pim.

Kava ishunv yemba honamba, wo kava sahmanav Sesoam, osm kamba nongla wulluhvra, osm memba honamba tanamolnam. Kava noinda Korinmba yeindamba hengamba promba owai vinna, ata yem homeis kin vrahunvm. Doata.

Kava osva ovmoa, osmba katatanana novsra yena undnahonamba amnalmba Sesoamba luhunvra, owai. Yimba keknam lehra undnahonamba av. Wo heva os katatanamba andranind yemongo, yena pevna beswonamangas losnamonamangasm alm.
